SummaryRow.note: The three-kind chip row (loops / terminals / native subagents) with the '·' separators, on a composer-toned bar. Live counts brighten their glyphs as the source intends.

SingleKind.note: Single-chip case — the row still reads as a live-state summary, no orphan separator.

ClickableChips.note: Chips with panels wired become real PopoverButton triggers; at rest they are visually identical to the summary form, which is the intended affordance.

AgentsPanelOpen.note: Mount-time click on the agents chip opens the portalled ComposerPopoverSurface above the bar with AgentsRosterPanel inside. Popover, anchor and bar all photograph together.
